subject: Edge log aggregator onboarding — DPA amendment and flow-down language request
messages:
From: Ops Team <ops@logstream.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2028-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: EdgeLog aggregator onboarding — subprocessor notice & DPA addendum

Hi Connor,

Quick heads up: LogStream is adding an edge-log aggregator (EdgeBridge) that will accept telemetry from on-prem collectors and forward compressed logs to our EU ingestion cluster. This change introduces a third-party "aggregation" subprocessor (EdgeBridge Inc.). Per our contract with Acme Retail, we need to notify you and provide the updated subprocessor details and a proposed DPA addendum.

Attached: high-level architecture (EdgeLog_Overview.pdf) and our proposed DPA addendum (DPA_Addendum_draft.docx).

Key asks from our side so we can proceed:
- Confirmation that Redwood will accept the flow-down language below (we included an initial suggested clause in flowdown-suggested-clause.txt).
- Any objections within 15 business days so we can route approvals.
- If Acme requires more than notice (e.g., execution of a separate annex or additional SCCs), please flag ASAP — we have a procurement window next week.

Short summary of the subprocessor: EdgeBridge Inc., hosted in Ireland (AWS eu-west-1), performs short-term buffering + gzip compression. They do not persist unredacted PII beyond 7 days and support TLS in transit and AES-256 at rest. We can provide the SOC2 report and certs on request.

Happy to set a 30-minute sync with legal if that helps.

Best,
Raj Patel
Ops Team, LogStream

Attachment stubs: EdgeLog_Overview.pdf (pdf), DPA_Addendum_draft.docx (docx)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Ops Team <ops@logstream.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeLog aggregator onboarding — DPA amendment and flow-down language request

Raj — thanks for the heads up and the artifacts. I skimmed the DPA addendum and the flowdown language. A couple of immediate notes from product/procurement:

- We need the subprocessor list to include: scope of processing, data types (log level / redaction policy), and retention by environment (dev/staging/prod).
- Please confirm whether EdgeBridge will access any customer-provided encryption keys or if keys are fully managed by LogStream. If they touch key material we need KMS/HSM details and key custody policy.
- Can you confirm the expected peak QPS to the EU cluster (ballpark) so we can validate throughput requirements on our dedicated pool?

I looped in Kimberly (legal lead on DPAs) and Laura (customer success) to triage the compliance questions. Kimberly — any initial redline requests?

Connor
Sr. Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Ops Team <ops@logstream.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-12T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeLog aggregator onboarding — DPA amendment and flow-down language request

Connor / Raj — thanks. After a quick review here are legal's asks and suggested edits to the flow-down clause. I attached a short text file with in-line suggestions but summary below: 

1) Notice and Objection Window: 30 days' notice for addition of a new subprocessor and a 14-day right-to-object for customers (Redwood will extend objections to Acme where contractually required).
2) Equivalent Obligations: Subprocessors must accept the same data protection obligations as in our DPA (confidentiality, security, subprocess restrictions, liability carveouts). Add explicit language requiring flow-down of encryption, breach notification timelines, and data deletion on termination.
3) Cross-Border Transfer Safeguards: Because EdgeBridge is in Ireland, include express acknowledgement that if data moves outside the EEA we will rely on SCCs or an equivalent adequacy mechanism; include a mandate that EdgeBridge provide a signed copy of the SCCs or confirm reliance on LogStream’s existing SCC implementation.
4) Evidence & Audit rights: Require SOC2 Type II or ISO27001 within 45 calendar days of onboarding, plus a quarterly security attestations feed for the first 6 months. Limit audit scope to processing relevant to Redwood/Acme.
5) Retention & Redaction: EdgeBridge must support configurable log redaction at ingest (PII tokenization) and guarantee that unredacted PII is not persisted beyond 7 days in the aggregator.

We'll propose tracked redlines to your DPA addendum and a short annex for the Order Form (if Acme requests a signed annex). For now, Raj — please confirm the SOC2 timeline and whether EdgeBridge will accept flowdown obligations.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: flowdown-suggested-clause.txt (text)

From: Ops Team <ops@logstream.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acme-retail.com>, security@acme-retail.com
Date: 2028-08-13T10:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeLog aggregator onboarding — DPA amendment and flow-down language request

Thanks Kimberly — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers: 

- EdgeBridge will not hold customer KMS keys; keys remain with LogStream and are managed by our KMS (AWS KMS with customer CMKs available on request). We can confirm key custodianship language in the addendum.
- SOC2 Type II report: we can provide an interim SOC2 report within 10 business days and the full latest report within 30 days.
- Peak QPS: projected initial peak ~3k events/sec for Acme in peak hours; average ~400 events/sec.
- Redaction: EdgeBridge supports configurable tokenization at ingest; default policy will strip email addresses and full credit card PANs unless explicitly toggled by the customer.

We accept the flow-down obligations in principle and are happy to sign the flow-down annex. We'll incorporate Kimberly's redlines and send a tracked version by EOD tomorrow.

Would Acme prefer a standalone annex to the Order Form or an addendum inside the DPA? Maya — can you indicate preference?

Regards,
Raj Patel
Ops Team, LogStream

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acme-retail.com>
To: Ops Team <ops@logstream.io>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, security@acme-retail.com, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-15T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeLog aggregator onboarding — DPA amendment and flow-down language request

Thanks everyone — Acme prefers a standalone annex to the Order Form that references the DPA. A couple of notes from our InfoSec: 

- Please provide the SOC2 interims and the specific SCC spreadsheet showing which modules/controls apply to cross-border transfers.
- We also need a short-term runbook: contact matrix for incidents, expected MTTD/MTTR SLAs for aggregator incidents, and a plan for forensic evidence preservation for 30 days.

Connor / Kimberly — can Redwood produce the annex language (one page) for Acme to review? If possible, we'd like a first draft by Aug 18 so procurement can approve next week.

Best,
Maya Singh
Senior Procurement Lead, Acme Retail

---
Summary of attachments exchanged: EdgeLog_Overview.pdf (architecture), DPA_Addendum_draft.docx (vendor draft), flowdown-suggested-clause.txt (Redwood suggestions).
